title: A gate answer the orchestrator commits on a worker branch survives the worker's later item writes
goal: a gate answer written to an item file after a command loaded the item is kept when that command saves it, so a worker's done or set no longer wipes an answer the orchestrator committed on its branch while the checks ran; an answer the command itself cleared stays cleared; kb/_self/backlog.md says an answer committed on a worker branch survives the worker's later item writes

run:
import sys, json, pathlib, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base
r = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = r / bl_base.rel_dir(); d.mkdir(parents=True)
f = d / 'BG-aaaaaaaa.json'
gate = {"id": "g1", "kind": "provisional", "question": "q", "options": ["a", "b"], "recommendation": "a"}
f.write_text(bl_base.canonical({"id": "BG-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "bug", "title": "t", "status": "todo", "gates": [gate]}), encoding='utf-8')
bl = bl_base.Backlog(r); it = bl.items['BG-aaaaaaaa']
disk = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); disk['gates'][0].update(answer='a', by='operator')
f.write_text(bl_base.canonical(disk), encoding='utf-8')
it['status'] = 'done'; bl.save(it)
got = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
ok = got['status'] == 'done' and got['gates'][0].get('answer') == 'a' and got['gates'][0].get('by') == 'operator'
print('answer kept' if ok else 'answer wiped', got['gates'][0])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys, json, pathlib, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_base
r = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = r / bl_base.rel_dir(); d.mkdir(parents=True)
f = d / 'BG-aaaaaaaa.json'
gate = {"id": "g1", "kind": "provisional", "question": "q", "options": ["a", "b"], "recommendation": "a", "answer": "a", "by": "agent"}
f.write_text(bl_base.canonical({"id": "BG-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "bug", "title": "t", "status": "todo", "gates": [gate]}), encoding='utf-8')
bl = bl_base.Backlog(r); it = bl.items['BG-aaaaaaaa']
for k in ('answer', 'by'):
    it['gates'][0].pop(k)
bl.save(it)
got = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
ok = 'answer' not in got['gates'][0]
print('cleared stays cleared' if ok else 'cleared answer came back', got['gates'][0])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
miss=[w for w in ['answer committed on a worker branch survives'] if w not in t]
sys.exit('not yet: kb/_self/backlog.md lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)
